sections.body: ==Software Test Automation Engineer== with 6+ years in QA and test automation, ==developing and maintaining automated test scripts== and ==bringing automation frameworks to maturity==. ==Automated 270+ regression test cases== using BrowserStack LCNC and ACCELQ and developed ==API-level regression tests== with Postman and REST Assured, including ==backend and database state validation== using SQL. ==Strong understanding of automation framework design patterns== (Page Object Model, API-first test setup) and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), with hands-on version control (Git) and Agile/Scrum delivery. ==Experience across UI user journeys and Electron/desktop surfaces via web and mobile application testing==; currently ==upskilling in Playwright and TypeScript== through structured training in Generative AI-assisted and modern automation testing.

If you can name any Playwright or TypeScript scripts you wrote (even small ones), fill them; otherwise this role is a stretch and should open with a cover note naming the gap.
